## GBlockKind type

Discriminator identifying which `getG*` block a result was rendered from.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type GBlockKind = `message` | `media` | `poll` | `venue` | `dice` | `keyboard` | `callbackAnswer` | `preCheckoutError` | `shippingError` | `inlineButton` | `answerNote` | `webAppAnswer` | `gift` | `invoice` | `paidMedia` | `description`;
```

## Remarks

One member per `TemplateManager.getG*` getter. Consumers narrow the `G*Result` payloads by `kind`<!-- -->; every payload carries its fields flat alongside this discriminator.
